fusions.name: Running Bond
fusions.desc: Throws a link on a chain that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of the damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unlinking
fusions.desc: A wrenching blow that deals 16 damage and tears out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one torn out. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Come Along
fusions.desc: Lays a line of links 6 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Through-Stone Tally
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (204% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
